fields.name: searchHint
fields.label: Search Placeholder Text
fields.description: Placeholder text shown in the search input field.

fields.name: searchIcon
fields.label: Search Icon Type
fields.description: Controls whether the search field shows no icon, a font icon, or an image icon.

fields.name: searchIconText
fields.label: Search Font Icon
fields.description: Font icon name; visible only when Search Icon Type = Icon Font.

fields.name: searchIconAlt
fields.label: Search Image Icon
fields.description: Image icon asset; visible only when Search Icon Type = Image.

fields.name: categoryTags
fields.label: Category Tags
fields.description: Parent taxonomy tag(s). The browse control lists the child tags beneath the selected parent(s). Leave empty to hide the category browse UI.

fields.name: browseCategories
fields.label: Browse Categories Placeholder Text
fields.description: Label for the browse-categories dropdown; overrides the parent tag title.

fields.name: resetCategories
fields.label: Reset Categories Placeholder Text
fields.description: Reset control label. Populating this field enables the reset control.

fields.name: linkSource
fields.label: Link Source
fields.description: Child Pages: auto-list from the site index. Icons / Custom: author Link List Item blocks.

fields.name: parentPage
fields.label: Parent Page
fields.description: Root page path; child links are resolved from the site index under this path.

fields.name: childDepth
fields.label: Child Depth
fields.description: How many levels of descendants to include (1 = direct children only).

fields.name: excludeCurrentPage
fields.label: Exclude Current Page
fields.description: Omit the active page from the generated list.

fields.name: enableDescription
fields.label: Enable Description
fields.description: Show page description below each link (from index metadata).

fields.name: enableTags
fields.label: Enable Tags
fields.description: Display tags from the index when available.

fields.name: enableSubtitle
fields.label: Enable Subtitle
fields.description: Show subtitle field from the index when available.

fields.name: enableDate
fields.label: Enable Date
fields.description: Show published or last modified date from the index.

fields.name: orderBy
fields.label: Order By
fields.description: Sort field for generated links.

fields.name: maxItems
fields.label: Max Items
fields.description: Maximum number of links to output.

fields.name: layout
fields.label: Layout
fields.description: Column layout of the link list.

options.name: Two Columns – do not stack on mobile

fields.name: id
fields.label: Id
fields.description: Unique anchor ID used for deep-linking to this block.

fields.name: customClass
fields.label: Custom Class
fields.description: CSS class name(s) applied to the component wrapper.

fields.name: searchInId
fields.label: Search In ID
fields.description: Id of a separate content region to filter instead of (or in addition to) this block's own list.

fields.name: analyticsId
fields.label: Analytics Interaction ID
fields.description: Generated automatically from the block resource path at render time.

fields.name: link
fields.label: Link
fields.description: Destination path or external URL.

fields.name: openInNewTab
fields.label: Open in a new tab
fields.description: When enabled, opens the link target in a new browser tab/window.

fields.name: linkText
fields.label: Link Text
fields.description: Visible label; may default to the target page title when blank.

fields.name: subtitle
fields.label: Subtitle
fields.description: Optional subtitle displayed beneath the link text.

fields.name: description
fields.label: Description
fields.description: Supporting description for the link item.

fields.name: categoryTags
fields.label: Category Tags
fields.description: Taxonomy tags used to categorize this link item.

fields.name: iconType
fields.label: Icon Type
fields.description: Chooses the icon source method for the item.

fields.name: fontIcon
fields.label: Font Icon
fields.description: Font icon name; visible only when Icon Type = Icon Font.

fields.name: imageIcon
fields.label: Image Icon
fields.description: Image asset; visible only when Icon Type = Image.

fields.name: iconPosition
fields.label: Icon Position
fields.description: Places the icon before or after the link text.

fields.name: iconLink
fields.label: Icon Link
fields.description: Optional separate target when clicking the icon.

fields.name: enableConfirmationModal
fields.label: Enable Confirmation Modal
fields.description: Prompts the user with a modal before navigation.

fields.name: confirmationModalType
fields.label: Type of confirmation modal
fields.description: Style of the confirmation modal.

fields.name: modalId
fields.label: Modal ID
fields.description: Identifier of the modal to trigger.

fields.name: id
fields.label: Id
fields.description: Unique anchor ID for this list item.

fields.name: customClass
fields.label: Custom Class
fields.description: CSS class name(s) applied to the item container.

fields.name: analyticsId
fields.label: Analytics Interaction ID
fields.description: Generated automatically from the item resource path at render time.

fields.name: ariaLabel
fields.label: Aria Label
fields.description: Accessible label used when the link text is ambiguous.
